reauth_confirm.description: The Resideo Shutoff Valve integration needs to re-authenticate your account.

application_credentials.description:
Follow the [instructions]({developer_dashboard_url}) to create a Resideo developer application. You must set the application's callback/redirect URL to:
```
{redirect_url}
```
Then enter the application's **Consumer Key** as the OAuth Client ID and the **Consumer Secret** as the OAuth Client Secret.
